purpose: Awkward cases for the local business pack and what the page does about each.

status.handled: Defined behaviour, clear to the visitor and the owner.
status.partial: Copes, but someone may be left unaware.
status.open: Needs an owner decision or a feature this version excludes.

tested.yes: An automated check proves it (test/local-business.test.ts, or an e2e check).

edges.edge: The site has no booking link but has a phone.
edges.visitor_sees: A Call to reserve button.
edges.default_behavior: reserveMode returns phone mode; the link is tel:.

edges.edge: The site has neither a booking link nor a phone.
edges.visitor_sees: No reserve button and no reserve card. The slim bar is drawn only if an order link exists, with just that button.
edges.owner_sees: 'Add a booking link or phone' in the review list.
edges.default_behavior: reserveMode returns none and every reserve surface is omitted.

edges.edge: The booking link is not https (http, javascript:, #).
edges.visitor_sees: The same as no link.
edges.owner_sees: 'Check your booking link' in the review list.
edges.default_behavior: safeHref rejects it and the phone fallback applies.

edges.edge: The menu has no prices.
edges.visitor_sees: Dishes without prices; nothing in their place.
edges.default_behavior: priceText returns nothing; no placeholder is drawn.

edges.edge: The owner asks to hide prices.
edges.visitor_sees: No price anywhere, including the highlight cards.
edges.default_behavior: menu.showPrices false; every price call goes through priceText.

edges.edge: There is no menu at all.
edges.visitor_sees: No Menu section and no Menu link in the top bar.
edges.owner_sees: 'Menu not found' in the review list.
edges.default_behavior: visibleSections omits menu; the nav follows.

edges.edge: The menu has 100 or more dishes and 10 or more categories.
edges.visitor_sees: Category chips that scroll sideways, then every category in order.
edges.default_behavior: FullMenu renders all items; chips scroll with overflow-x.

edges.edge: A category has no items, or two dishes share a name.
edges.visitor_sees: The empty category is not drawn; both dishes show.
edges.default_behavior: Empty categories are filtered; list keys use name and position.

edges.edge: The owner's menu has spelling mistakes or odd capitals.
edges.visitor_sees: The same words as the owner's site.
edges.default_behavior: Text is copied as is; the builder does not correct it.

edges.edge: The owner has not confirmed the pictures are theirs.
edges.visitor_sees: Colour blocks with labels, no photographs, no highlight cards.
edges.owner_sees: 'Confirm your pictures to show them' in the review list.
edges.default_behavior: usePhotos false.

edges.edge: Fewer than three pictures or labels.
edges.visitor_sees: No gallery section.
edges.default_behavior: galleryTiles has fewer than three entries and the section is omitted.

edges.edge: The number of pictures does not fill the grid.
edges.visitor_sees: A full last row.
edges.default_behavior: galleryTiles trims the count so every row is full.

edges.edge: Pictures have blank alt text.
edges.visitor_sees: They do not become dish pictures and have no caption.
edges.default_behavior: Matching needs alt equal to the dish name.

edges.edge: A picture address fails to load.
edges.visitor_sees: A broken-image icon.
edges.default_behavior: Not handled in this version.

edges.edge: The site shows no testimonials.
edges.visitor_sees: No reviews section.
edges.default_behavior: visibleSections omits reviews.

edges.edge: A quote has no rating or no author.
edges.visitor_sees: The quote alone, no stars.
edges.default_behavior: stars returns 0 unless a whole rating from 1 to 5 was read.

edges.edge: There is no about text.
edges.visitor_sees: No about section.
edges.default_behavior: visibleSections omits about.

edges.edge: There is no catering content, or only a paragraph.
edges.visitor_sees: Nothing, or heading and paragraph without cards.
edges.default_behavior: The band draws only what exists.

edges.edge: Only one way to order exists.
edges.visitor_sees: No Ways to enjoy us section.
edges.default_behavior: waysToOrder needs two cards.

edges.edge: No hours, no socials, or no email.
edges.visitor_sees: The column is not drawn; the others widen.
edges.default_behavior: footerColumns skips empty columns.

edges.edge: Hours are one line (Open every day 10 to 10) or seven lines.
edges.visitor_sees: Each line as written.
edges.default_behavior: Hours are lines of text, not a table.

edges.edge: The restaurant name is very long.
edges.visitor_sees: The top bar shortens it with an ellipsis; the hero shows it in full.
edges.default_behavior: min-width 0, overflow hidden, text-overflow ellipsis on the logo.

edges.edge: Names or text hold quotes, ampersands, angle brackets or non-Latin letters.
edges.visitor_sees: The text as written.
edges.default_behavior: React escapes text; nothing is set as raw HTML.

edges.edge: The accent colour is very light.
edges.visitor_sees: Text on the accent stays readable.
edges.default_behavior: --accent-text is chosen white or near-black by contrast. The reference stylesheet defaults to white, so the agent must set it.

edges.edge: The visitor prefers reduced motion.
edges.visitor_sees: No sliding or hover transitions.
edges.default_behavior: Transitions are switched off under prefers-reduced-motion.

edges.edge: The page is opened at 360px.
edges.visitor_sees: One column, no sideways scrolling.
edges.default_behavior: Responsive rules in restaurant.css.

edges.edge: A visitor opens an address that does not exist.
edges.visitor_sees: A short not-found page with a link home.
edges.default_behavior: not-found page.
